exact_statement: For every finite uniform Boolean g and physical coordinate i, mu=E(g),t=ghat({i}),d=Inf_i(g), the full entropy-row decrement L(mu,t) is at most lambda_row*d, where lambda_row is the unique global maximum of ell(b)/b on b in(0,1], ell(b)=L(1-b,b). The maximum occurs at the unique beta in((1-1/sqrt(5))/2,1/2) with beta*ell_prime(beta)-ell(beta)=0. Exact rational certificates give 2<lambda_row<9/4 and the root/price enclosures in ROOT.json and AUDIT.json (approximately2.152204859). This constant is sharp over actual finite Boolean exceptional rows, not asserted optimal for full signed composition drift. For every Boolean composition h(g_1,...,g_r) on disjoint physical blocks, signed correction C=H(F)-sum q_j H(g_j) satisfies mean C_child-C_parent<=lambda_row Inf_i(F). For every fixed real K>=0, U=C+kappa I(F)+sum q_j rho_K(g_j), with kappa=lambda_row or9/4, is a nonnegative full-query superharmonic majorant of(H(F)-KI(F))_+. Supplied credits/old signed labels/full terminals propagate by the stated kernels, including all real surplus D>=0. The rational9/4 envelope saves exactly3I(F)/4 against the source rational3 envelope. Its INITIAL influence price remains FEI-equivalent at every fixed K; no FEI solution is asserted.
hypotheses: Finite uniform physical cubes, outputs +/-1, complete squared-Fourier entropy in bits and ordinary physical influence.
L and eta use continuous zero conventions; scalar certificate covers all real |mu|+|t|<=1, |t|<=d.
Original outer gate/disjoint core partition is fixed under all physical restrictions, constants/dummies allowed.
Rate K>=0 is fixed throughout the history and rho_K is the full finite stopping hull at that same rate.
Credit is actually supplied and every original influence owner remains unused after previous bookings; all stopped siblings, actual reaches and full terminal functions are retained.
No optimality for full signed drift and no universal initial O(I) source are claimed.

exact_statement: For every Boolean outer gate h on three uniform output inputs, every Boolean core g on three uniform physical bits, and two fresh uniform dictator cores, let F=h(g,y1,y2) with g substituted in any selected gate input. For each relevant coordinate i of g with Inf_i(F)>0, let C=H(F)-q H(g), where q is the pivotal probability of the selected gate input under the other two uniform outputs. The maximum over this entire finite domain of (average_b C(F|x_i=b)-C(F))/Inf_i(F) is exactly 3 log2(3)-4. All entropies use full squared Fourier spectra in bits. In particular a universal full-drift coefficient 1/2 is false.
